report:
Distal right femur, segmental / wide resection

Received in formalin is a segmental / wide resection specimen of the distal right femur measuring 18 x 9 x 8 cm (includes distal femoral articular surface and overlying biopsy tract). Sectioning shows a gritty / ossified and necrotic tumour measuring 95 x 62 x 54 mm. The tumour destroys the cortex and extends into the adjacent soft tissue. Macroscopically, the tumour lies 6 mm from the closest (medial soft tissue margin) margin. Representative sections are taken in 16 blocks after formic acid decalcification.

(1-12) Slab-mapped tumour cross-section.
(13) Proximal bone marrow margin.
(14) Medial soft tissue margin.
(15) Anterior soft tissue margin.
(16) Biopsy tract.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Segmental / wide resection
- Tumour site: Appendicular skeleton, trunk, skull, and facial bones (distal
  right femur)
- Tumour location and extent: Metaphysis; Medullary cavity; Cortical; Tumour
  extension into soft tissue
- Tumour size: 95 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 95 x 62 x 54 mm

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Conventional osteosarcoma (osteoblastic subtype)
- Histologic grade: G3: Poorly differentiated, high grade
- Mitotic rate: 14 per 10 HPF
- Necrosis (in absence of neoadjuvant therapy): Not identified
- Treatment effect: Present (5% viable tumour (95% treatment-related necrosis);
  geographic necrosis, fibrosis and hyalinisation)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the distal right femur show conventional osteosarcoma (osteoblastic subtype). Proliferating pleomorphic, hyperchromatic malignant mesenchymal cells directly produce irregular lace-like and trabecular neoplastic osteoid.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by tumour
  - Proximal bone marrow: Uninvolved, 35 mm (block 13)
  - Medial soft tissue: Uninvolved, 6 mm (block 14)
  - Anterior soft tissue: >15 (block 15)
  - Biopsy tract: uninvolved (block 16)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: ypT2

Additional findings
- Preresection treatment: Chemotherapy performed

DISTAL RIGHT FEMUR, segmental / wide resection:
- CONVENTIONAL OSTEOSARCOMA (osteoblastic subtype), grade 3, 95 mm
- treatment effect present (95% necrosis / 5% viable tumour)
- Margins clear (closest 6 mm, medial soft tissue)
- ypT2 (AJCC 8th edition).
